cases.why: Literal::Nat(BigInt) infers the INDUCTIVE Nat, is defeq to Succ^n Zero, drives a Match, and an emitted structural add computes 2+3=5. Nat is not a subtype of Int, so the tempting Nat-as-Int emission is caught.

Arbitrary precision is shipped end to end: 2^63/2^64/30-digit literals type-check exactly, differ in their last digit, bridge to Succ in one peel, and int_lit's canonicality invariant holds across the i64 boundary in both directions.
i64::MIN stays machine-form, one below it widens, wide results demote back, and add/sub/mul compute across zero. No Int_negSucc/Int_ofNat shadow encoding exists to reach for.

Lean's Int is an inductive (ofNat/negSucc) that PROVES its ring and order laws; LOGOS's Int is an inductive with ZERO constructors plus 16 axioms. signOf, Int.natAbs, Int.toNat and every proof by cases on an integer are unstatable. The largest trusted-base liability in the tier.

The literal injects and infers Text, and literal equality/disequality survive — that is the whole residual semantics. Text is a zero-constructor opaque carrier, so String.mk, .data and the character layer are unrecoverable (Char is absent too).

Char is registered as Lean defines it — { val : UInt32 // val.isValidChar } — which needed both blocked layers first: Subtype as a structure, and UInt32 as Fin 2^32. isValidChar excludes the surrogate range by COMPUTATION (Nat_lt reduces), so a Char really is a scalar value and not a labelled UInt32. Text stays opaque, so the two dead-end re-encodings the case names are still dead ends.

Float is a labelled atom: the literal injects and nothing else exists — zero declared operations, zero axioms, zero reduction rules. Worse, literal defeq is Rust IEEE PartialEq, so def_eq is NOT reflexive at NaN and 0.0 is definitionally identified with -0.0.

Bool is the prelude's two-constructor inductive, le/lt/ge return its bare true/false globals, a positional Match dispatches correctly, and the decide/Decidable bridge computes. Registration order is true-then-false — the OPPOSITE of Lean's false-then-true.

UInt8/16/32/64/USize are registered as Fin 2^N, Lean's own definition — a Nat carrying a proof it is below the width, so the carrier cannot hold an out-of-range value and cannot be confused with Nat. The WRAPPING ARITHMETIC is still absent: LOGOS arithmetic is exact by construction, so modular ops must be defined, which needs Nat +/% plus Nat.mod_lt. The case's assertion is registration; the arithmetic is tracked by prelude_types_extra's machine-word test.

BitVec is absent. The similarly-named BVec is a Bit cons-list whose complete operation surface is bv_and/bv_or/bv_xor/bv_not — no arithmetic, no shifts, no toNat/ofNat. BVec's separate params/indices misdeclaration is defect 8, reproduced in lean_conformance_defects.

Array A is a structure over List A, as Lean's is, with Array_size, Array_push and an Array_get that TAKES THE BOUND PROOF (Nat_lt i (Array_size A a)) — so there is no out-of-range call to decide behaviour for. All four compute: size_push holds by reduction. The TList substitution the case warns about is avoided because indexing is bound-checked rather than defaulting.

List A is registered parametric with nil before cons, plus List_rec, List_length, List_append and List_get; TList and EList are untouched. The recursor and all three operations ι-reduce — which required hoisting the type parameter OUTSIDE the Fix, because the kernel unfolds a fixpoint only when the argument it is IMMEDIATELY applied to is constructor-form. Not universe-polymorphic: List_rec's motive is List A -> Type 0.

All six are registered at Type 0: Option (none before some), Prod/Sigma/Subtype via add_structure (so eta and the dependent second projection hold), Sum, and Fin as Subtype Nat (i < n). The Nat order the bound needed is new and is a COMPUTATION, not a second axiom set — natLe/natLt by structural recursion, Nat_lt i n = Eq Bool (natLt i n) true — so a bound proof is refl when the bound holds and uninhabited when it does not, and Fin 0 is empty by reduction. Universe polymorphism is still absent: these are the Type 0 instances and nothing above.

No OfNat class and no default-instance concept. A literal's type is read off its VARIANT, never off the context, and elaborating 5 against an expected Int is not an error — it silently returns the Nat literal. A user OfNat instance is dropped entirely.

The accelerated numeral is definitionally Succ^n Zero in BOTH kernels (double_check agrees), a Match peels one Succ in O(1) so pred 50000 stays a compact literal, and literal-vs-literal equality is decided by BigInt comparison rather than peeling.
Not one Text operation is declared anywhere in the prelude. The axiom repair is demonstrated to fail: Text_append type-checks, never reduces, and the rfl Lean proves is therefore FALSE in LOGOS.

LOGOS ships no Nat arithmetic; its sub is an Int axiom that goes negative, and on Nat literals it is both ill-typed and stuck — the double refusal that keeps the conflation loud. An emitted structural recursion truncates correctly but 5007-5000 silently exhausts normalize's 10000-step fuel.

A SILENT WRONG ANSWER. Lean's / and % on Int are Euclidean; LOGOS's div/mod truncate toward zero with the remainder carrying the dividend's sign. 370 disagreements over a -20..20 by -6..6 grid, 82 violations of 0 <= a % b, and a zero divisor leaves the term stuck where Lean totalises.
